The '''NovaCORE kelerium processing plant''' was a [[Kelerium/Legends|kelerium]] refinery operating for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] in [[The Works/Legends|The Works]] industrial district on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the plant was nearly 100% automated with only three [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarians]] as employees. [[Kaa'to Leeachos]], a [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], took shelter in the plant after he betrayed the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]], a powerful underworld syndicate, who subsequently dispatched a group of agents to apprehend the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]].<ref name="UABS" />
